verdicts.flaw_description: The purchase figures 'cover the sessions that reached the new page' while 'a quarter of each segment dropped out before checkout' - so the 4-7 percent lift is computed only on the selected three-quarters that got as far as the checkout page, a narrower population than the claim that the page 'increases purchases' overall.

'Pollen counts in each group's district ran a fifth below the previous quarter, and every group lived and slept on the district's outside air' - a 20 percent pollen drop is a named alternative cause that reaches all four groups and by itself explains 4-7 fewer asthma attacks versus the previous quarter.

'Averages cover the patients who kept up the home exercises, and a quarter of each intake let the home exercises lapse' - the 9-16 degree gains are measured only on the compliant three-quarters, excluding the lapsed quarter, so the numbers describe a self-selected subgroup rather than the intakes that completed the protocol.

'Rates cover the boards soldered on the new profile throughout, and about a tenth of each run's boards took one pass on the old profile' - roughly 10 percent of each run's boards are dropped from the defect rate on a basis (mixed processing) that plausibly correlates with defects, so the 4-7 percent reduction covers a narrower board population than the run as a whole.
